text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — final EBR with Acme is next Wed 9:00am PT. Need slide owners, a short runbook of the flow, and demo fallbacks by EOD Fri.
Priya Raman: Thanks — I'll own the agenda / slide order and coord presenters. Will share a stub in a bit.
Jorge Alvarez: I can own the live demo but want a clear fallback if the staging model has perf issues.
Mike Chen: I'll take the latency & capacity slide. Note: we updated 99p latency in the last run — slide 6 needs the new numbers (p95 120ms, p99 450ms).
Linh Vu: I'll prep the exec cue cards (one-pagers per exec ask) — want to keep them to 3 bullets each.
Maya Patel: Good. Jorge — add a scripted fallback path. Priya — once you drop the stub, mention which slides are auto-refreshing dashboards vs static screenshots.
Jorge Alvarez: Putting a lightweight fallback in the runbook: if model > 700ms/p99, switch demo to recorded clip. Also include a warm endpoint switch: `POST /v1/switch-endpoint {"route":"demo-fallback"}` (devops approved).
Priya Raman: Stub: 
```
Run order: 1) Intro (Maya) 2) Health + adoption (Priya) 3) Latency/cost (Mike) 4) Demo (Jorge) 5) Ask / next steps (Maya)
Dry-run: Tue 3pm PT (all presenters)
Slide owners: callouts inline in deck
Fallback: recorded clip + config to point demo traffic to fallback endpoint
```
Mike Chen: Re: slide 6 redline — here's the blurb I need on the slide footer: "Latest perf numbers from 03/18/2026; tail latency after batch tuning". Keep it short.
Maya Patel: Can someone own the recorded clip? It should be 90s max and show the happy path + one failure scenario. Jorge?
Jorge Alvarez: Will do. I'll record 2 clips: 1) happy path 2) degraded scenario with manual fallback. Uploading to shared drive by Thu.
Linh Vu: Cue cards draft coming shortly. Also prepping a 1-sentence backup ask if execs push for immediate cost savings.
deploy-bot: Scheduled dry-run job created: EBR-dryrun-176987 - Tue 03/24 15:00 PT — reminder ping 30m prior.
Maya Patel: Awesome. Action list for EOD Fri: Priya post stub + slide map, Mike update slide 6 footnote, Jorge upload clips + runbook snippet, Linh post cue cards. I'll compile and do final polish on Mon morning. :thumbsup:
